services.name: Nature Tour
services.desc: 4-hour: $800 6-hour: $950 Get your cameras out and ready as we explore the Backcountry of the Florida Keys! Prepare to see and learn about the magnificent creatures of our waters and islands as Captain Landon Johnson gives you the full tour of what we call the “Backcountry”. The Backcountry waters have an average depth of 1-6’ keeping our waters consistently calm, making it a great excursion for all family members regardless of the fear of getting “sea sick”. The huge variety of sea life and birds will keep your eyes busy through out the entire day, every where you look there will be animals swimming, crawling or flying!
